text:
Raj Patel: Heads up — interviewer reminder emails are sending the wrong scorecard link after last night's ATS migration. The link is going to /candidates/ID instead of the new /profiles/ID/scorecard. Getting a few panicked DMs from hiring managers.

Priya Singh: Oof. Any idea how many reminders went out with the bad link?

Raj Patel: Quick grep on sent reminders shows ~46 reminders between 02:00–03:30 UTC. Probably mostly senior IC interviews.

Maya Chen: @Raj can you paste an example of the email body? We need something we can show Eng for a hotfix.

Raj Patel: Sure — snippet below:

Subject: Interview reminder: Backend SWE
Body: "Hi Lin, you have an interview with Casey at 10:00am. Please submit your scorecard: https://ats.redwood.internal/candidates/83421/scorecard"

Correct link should be:
https://ats.redwood.internal/profiles/83421/scorecard

Lin Zhao: I saw this too. I clicked and got the generic candidate landing page, not the scorecard form. Ended up filling manually which added friction. Not great for interview quality.

Maya Chen: Can we ship a patch that rewrites the template while we fix the canonical mapping? If integrations team can update the reminder template to use the new token var, we can avoid more bad emails.

Raj Patel: I looked into the webhook payload from ATS -> our reminders service. It contains a `candidate_id` and a `profile_path` but our template was still using `{{candidate_url}}` which resolves to /candidates/{{id}}. The migration introduced `{{profile_url}}`.

Lin Zhao: If it's just the template variable, a config change sounds safe. Who owns that config?

Maya Chen: @integrations-bot / @ats-admin-bot — can you confirm where the "Interviewer Reminder" template lives and whether we can change the token to `{{profile_url}}`?

integrations-bot: Template: Interviewer Reminder located in ATS -> Admin -> Notifications -> Templates. Current template variables: `{{candidate_url}}`, `{{candidate_name}}`, `{{interview_time}}`. New variable `{{profile_url}}` available post-migration but not yet in use.

ats-admin-bot: Quick rollback option: we can patch the template to use `{{profile_url}}` immediately. Doing so affects only the reminder email template. Will require a 5-min maintenance window to validate tokens.

Priya Singh: Please do it. Can we also send a short correction email to the impacted interviewers?

Raj Patel: I'll draft the correction email copy. For the hotfix here's the manual curl the integrations team can run against the ATS admin API if they prefer an API patch (replace $TKN & $TEMPLATE_ID):

```
curl -X PATCH "https://ats.redwood.internal/api/v1/templates/$TEMPLATE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TKN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"body":"Hi {{interviewer_name}}, you have an interview at {{interview_time}}. Submit your scorecard: {{profile_url}}"}'
```

Maya Chen: Great. Integration team, please coordinate and update here when complete. Also let's add an automated smoke test for reminder links to catch this earlier.

integrations-bot: Patch applied to template ID 309. Performing smoke test now.

integrations-bot: Smoke test results: reminder email renders scorecard link -> https://ats.redwood.internal/profiles/83421/scorecard. Test passed.

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks. Raj, please send the correction note to the 46 interviewers and include the correct link template. Also add a short postmortem item: update our migration checklist to verify template variable mappings for all notification templates.

Raj Patel: On it. Drafted copy below for review:
"Hi — an earlier reminder email contained an invalid link to the scorecard. Sorry about the confusion. Please use the correct link format: https://ats.redwood.internal/profiles/{candidate_id}/scorecard. If you already submitted manually, thanks — no action needed. Otherwise, please use the link above to open the scorecard. — Raj"

Priya Singh: Fine by me. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. :rocket:

ats-admin-bot: Logged incident INC-2026-042 in our tracking board and assigned to Integrations.

Maya Chen: Follow-ups: (1) Raj to send correction email, (2) Integrations to add smoke test and monitor reminders for 24h, (3) Ops to add template mapping check to migration playbook. I'll update the playbook doc and ping when done.

Raj Patel: Correction email sent to 46 interviewers at 04:45 UTC. Will monitor replies.

integrations-bot: Monitoring active — no further bad reminder sends in the last 90 minutes.

Maya Chen: Closing thread for now. Thanks all. :clap:
